name: get_weather
description: Get current weather for a city in Asturias or Picos de Europa. Use this when the visitor asks about weather conditions. Supported cities: Oviedo, Gijón, Avilés, Llanes, Cangas de Onís, Cudillero, Luarca, Ribadesella, Covadonga, Picos de Europa, Fuente Dé.

request_body_schema.description: The city or location name in Asturias that the user is asking about the weather for. Extract from the conversation.

city.description: City name for weather lookup. Infer from story context if user says 'here' or 'there'.
